package.description: Orchestrate Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build as sub-agents of each other from one executable.

en-US.description: Orchestrate Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build as sub-agents of each other from one executable.
en-US.longDescription:
Axiopera connects Claude Code, Codex, and Grok Build so the lead agent can dispatch the others as sub-agents and receive their results. Lighter, more efficient agent collaboration with minimal setup changes: one executable plus one skill, and your existing agent sign-ins and usage allowances are reused, so agent configuration stays unchanged by default.
A lead agent can ask for review or work from the other agents, add instructions and change direction while they run, and follow every sub-task live in another terminal with axiopera top. Tasks share your working directory unless --cwd selects another, and parallel writers should each use their own git worktree. A background daemon coordinates the sessions.
The same binary is a command line: axiopera create, send, reply, watch, top, daemon and status subcommands drive tasks, approvals and progress reporting, and cancelled tasks can be resumed.
en-US.name: Axiopera
en-US.releaseNotes:
Fixed
- macOS: inside an agent's sandbox, such as Claude Code's command sandbox, axiopera no longer starts the daemon and asks you to re-run the command outside the sandbox. A daemon started there stayed in the sandbox, passed it on to every sub-agent, and gave them the sandbox's network proxy settings.
- Windows: a process in the Codex sandbox can no longer add an instance of the daemon's named pipe and receive other clients' requests, including the environment that spawn sends. Clients also refuse a pipe served by a sandboxed process.
- If the data directory is read-only or not writable, axiopera asks you to re-run the command outside the agent sandbox instead of reporting only the system error.
- Linux: axiopera top no longer misses a task update that the daemon saves within a few milliseconds of the previous one.
Other notes
- Sub-agents can no longer run axiopera daemon stop, skill install or plugin cleanup; run them from the main session or a terminal. Version-mismatch errors shown to sub-agents no longer suggest daemon stop --force.
- On Linux the client does not check whether it runs in a sandbox. With Grok's --sandbox workspace and a data directory the sandbox can write, it can still start the daemon inside the sandbox.
- Stop the daemon with axiopera daemon stop before replacing the executable.
- Updating the Codex plugin may require trusting it again.

zh-CN.description: 把 Claude Code、Codex 和 Grok Build 互相编排成子 agent 的协作工具，一个可执行文件加一个 skill 即可接入。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Axiopera 打通 Claude Code、Codex 与 Grok Build，让主 agent 把它们派生为子 agent 并接收结果。更轻量、更高效、更易用的 agent 协作，对现有配置的改动很小：一个可执行文件加一个 skill，沿用你已有的 agent 登录态和用量额度，默认不改动 agent 配置。
主 agent 可以请其他 agent 审阅或干活，运行中随时追加指令、改变方向，也可以在另一个终端用 axiopera top 实时查看所有子任务。任务默认共用当前工作目录，`--cwd` 可另行指定，并行写入的任务应各用一个 git worktree。后台守护进程负责协调各个会话。
同一个程序也是命令行：axiopera create、send、reply、watch、top、daemon、status 等子命令负责派发任务、审批和进度上报，已取消的任务还能续接。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
agent 沙箱在 macOS 上不能再启动 daemon，在 Windows 上不能再冒充 daemon，子 agent 也不能再停止 daemon。
修复
- macOS：在 agent 的沙箱中（例如 Claude Code 的命令沙箱），axiopera 不再启动 daemon，而是提示到沙箱外重新运行。此前在沙箱中启动的 daemon 会一直留在沙箱里，它启动的每个子 agent 也都受沙箱限制，并沿用沙箱的网络代理设置。
- Windows：Codex 沙箱中的进程不能再为 daemon 的命名管道另建实例、接收其他客户端的请求，包括 spawn 携带的环境变量。客户端也会拒绝由沙箱进程提供的管道。
- 数据目录只读或无权写入时，提示到 agent 沙箱外重新运行，不再只报系统错误。
- Linux：daemon 在几毫秒内连续两次更新同一任务时，axiopera top 不再漏掉后一次更新。
其它说明
- 子 agent 不能再执行 axiopera daemon stop、skill install 和 plugin cleanup，请在主会话或终端中运行。子 agent 遇到版本不一致时，报错不再建议 daemon stop --force。
- Linux 客户端不检查自身是否在沙箱中。使用 Grok 的 --sandbox workspace 且沙箱可写数据目录时，仍可能在沙箱中启动 daemon。
- 替换程序前先执行 axiopera daemon stop。
- 更新 Codex 插件后可能需要重新信任插件。
